title: Largeness notions and polytime translation for $\forall Σ^0_3$-consequences of $\mathsf{RT}^2_2$
summary: Le Houérou, Patey and Yokoyama defined a parameterized version of $α$-largeness to prove that $\mathsf{WKL}_0 + \mathsf{RT}^2_2$ is a $\forall Σ^0_3$-conservative extension of $\mathsf{RCA}_0 + \mathsf{B}Σ^0_2$, where $\forall Σ^0_3$ is the universal set-closure of the class of $Σ^0_3$-formulas. We introduce a variant of this notion of largeness and obtain polynomial bounds, using a tree partition theorem based on Milliken's tree theorem.
